rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Quiet kerb backing onto bush, nearest home about 16 m away.
reasons: Backs onto bush, no homes 60-85 m

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the kerb; dwellings mapped 23 m back at 55 m and 16 m at 90 m along.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a narrow grass and bush verge; a few cars park near the lower end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park here, no campers; signs restrict only weekday 9am-5pm.

flags: Homes 10 m away at 9 and 21 m, so avoid the top end
sun_shade: Dense canopy from the bush on this side, shade on the morning and midday sun.

best_section.where: North kerb of Dell Road, bush side, past the vacant lot opposite
